positions.title: Customer Service Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Supervise between 3+ to 17+ cashiers at the time plus 9 departments at the time with 1+ to 3+ employees per department on shifts of 6+ to 8+ hours per day and 20+ to 35+ hours per week. 
•	Manage schedules and duties of the cashiers and sales floor employees.
•	Manage pickups of money during the day, bring change to the cashiers, count all the money at the end of the day and make the deposit of $50,000+ to $200,000+ between season.

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
•	Customer service development by helping between 40 to 100 customers on a regular day. 
•	Answered, screened and forwarded about 30 calls to appropriate department staff. 
•	Money managed by operate cash register with up to $500 to $2,000.

volunteerExperiences.description: •	Participate as a mentor and volunteer in the NCWIT AspireIT Program, hosted by Latinitas and ACM-W to engage more girls in technology and assist the Program Leader in the daily workshops by overseeing logistics and agenda. Motivate groups of about 30 to 40 girls from 4th -8th grade to perform programming related activities such as 3D-Printing, virtual reality, web development and wearable technology.

organizations.name: ACM-W WiCS
organizations.description:
•	Founder of ACM-W WiCS, collaborating with the officers to rebrand ACM-W student organization. Grew club from 25+ to 90+ members through enhanced recruiting, monthly development workshops, and 15+ tech companies visit.
•	Generate fund request by proposals and manage it towards the logistics of events. Also, manage about $1,000+ by keeping track of the organization account and receipts.
